dialog.english: What is it?
Do you like your mom, T.K?
Of course I do!

Who do you like more, me or your
mom?
dialog.translation:
¿A quién quieres más, a mí
o a tu mamá?

dialog.english: My mom!
*waaaaah*

I'm kidding, don't cry! Honestly,
I like you just as much as I like
my mom.
dialog.translation:
¡Es broma, no llores! Te
quiero tanto como a mi
mamá, de verdad.

dialog.english: T.K, you meanie...
It's Mommy! Patamon, hide!
O-okay!
T.K!
Ah! Welcome back, Mommy!

T.K, were you just talking to
that stuffed animal?
dialog.translation:
T.K., ¿hablabas con ese
muñeco de peluche?

dialog.english:
(What should I do? I can't tell
her about Patamon...)
dialog.translation:
(¿Qué hago? No puedo hablarle
de Patamon...)

dialog.english: No, I wasn't talking to anyone.

I'm sure heard you talking to
someone.
dialog.translation:
Te he oído hablar con
alguien, seguro.

dialog.english: I was just talking to myself...

(T.K, she'll be able to see
through a lie like that in no time
flat!)
dialog.translation:
(T.K., ¡esa mentira la va a
pillar en un segundo!)

dialog.english:
(Maybe T.K's stressed out from
our divorce...)
dialog.translation:
(Puede que T.K. esté mal por
el divorcio...)

dialog.english:
Have you been doing okay lately,
T.K? Are you sleeping and
eating enough?
dialog.translation:
¿Estás bien últimamente,
T.K.? ¿Duermes y comes lo
suficiente?

dialog.english: Of course I am. I'm doing fine!

Really? Well, anyway, let's head
home.
dialog.translation:
Ah, vale. Bueno, vamos ya
para casa.

dialog.english: Okay!

Oh, right. Mommy, let's go this
way today!
dialog.translation:
Ah, cierto. Mamá, ¡vayamos por
aquí hoy!

dialog.english: Huh? Why?

I heard there's a shortcut this
way.
dialog.translation:
Dicen que hay un atajo
por aquí.

dialog.english:
Huh, okay! It's nice to take
another route once in a while.
dialog.translation:
¡Anda, vale! Está bien cambiar
de camino de vez en cuando.

dialog.english:
It's nice to take another route
once in a while.
dialog.translation:
Está bien cambiar de camino
de vez en cuando.

dialog.english:
What should I make for tonight's
dinner?

I'm fine with whatever! I like
anything you make, Mommy.
dialog.translation:
¡Me vale cualquier cosa! Me
gusta lo que haces, mamá.

dialog.english: Hey! Found you!
A... a talking spider?! Ah!
Mama!

It's Dokugumon! T.K, get down!
Oops, I talked...

It's okay, Patamon, it looks like
Mommy fainted.
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo, Patamon, mamá
parece que se desmayó.

dialog.english:
Mommy hates spiders even more than
she hates cockroaches.
dialog.translation:
Mamá odia las arañas incluso
más que las cucarachas.

dialog.english:
Hey, hey, Chosen Child! Gimme your
Tag and Crest!
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, eh, Niño Elegido! ¡Dame tu
Circuito y tu Emblema!

dialog.english:
I'm gonna protect T.K and his
mom!
dialog.translation:
¡Voy a proteger a T.K. y a
su mamá!

dialog.english: Mama!

T.K! W-where's that spider
monster?

Monster? There was a spider, but
it was just a normal spider.
dialog.translation:
¿Monstruo? Había una araña, pero
era una araña normal.

dialog.english:
Huh?! But it was the size of a
person...

You must have thought it was
bigger out of shock. It's okay, 
I grabbed it and threw it away.
dialog.translation:
Debiste de verla más grande por
el susto. Tranquila, la cogí
y la tiré.

dialog.english:
(Maybe *I'm* the one who's worn
out, not T.K...)
dialog.translation:
(Creo que la que está agotada
soy yo, no T.K...)

dialog.english:
Yeah...Yeah, you're right, giant
spiders don't exist.
dialog.translation:
Sí, sí, tienes razón, las
arañas gigantes no existen.

dialog.english:
Right! Anyway, let's hurry up and
go home. I have so much to tell
you about camp.
dialog.translation:
¡Cierto! Bueno, vamos rápido a
casa. Tengo mucho que
contarte del campamento.

dialog.english: Yeah! Let's go home.

You seemed a lot more mature just
now. Maybe because of camp?
dialog.translation:
Pareces mucho más maduro
ahora. ¿Será por el campamento?

dialog.english: I grew up a little!
And just what do you mean by that?
Right, Patamon?
(Right, T.K!)
